notes.title: An Important Update
notes.content:
[p]Nettle's development is slowly approaching it's full release version, Nettle 1.0. So, we decided to share something very important concerning the project and some of our plans for the future.[/p][p]Firstly, we're very thankful for the support given to us by our community. All kinds of support and constructive criticism have helped us tremendously, step by step. This is our first big project and we're glad to share it with all of you.[/p][p][b]From the next update and so on, the game will not be free to claim anymore; It will be sold for it's standard price (15$). The game will remain in early access.[/b] We concluded that the original scope for the original concept has been fulfilled and that this decision also fits our needs for the continuation of development.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]Now, we introduce our [b]Roadmap[/b] that will lead us to [b]Nettle 1.0! [/b]There is so much more we plan to add before the initial release. Here are some of the updates that we plan on releasing during early access!
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45188207/60f0d31f99ccd0eca9896f9f01cdf79f6bb107e2.png"][/img]
In the next update, we will be adding an additional expedition that we are currently calling "[b]The Mushroom Swamp![/b]" The expedition will include new exclusive flora, fauna and a boss.[/p][p]Later, we want to add [b]rivers[/b] into the game. It will give depth to world exploration and interaction, as well as make space for new creative ways of making transportation around the world.[/p][p]Our furthest goal is to implement [b]a special anomaly[/b] that would drown the world in high seas...[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]That's it for now.[/p][p][b]Thank you for reading and for playing Nettle![/b][/p]

notes.title: Version B18
notes.content:
[p]This time we are focusing on various quality of life changes and bug fixes. Not a lot of new content, unfortunately. Here's the highlights, and as always, the full changelog at the bottom:[/p][p][b]???[/b][/p][p]Something weird is happening with this planet... Strange anomalies are being picked up planet-side by the sensors...[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45188207/6d9ca7649606e701a7b2f999d1dd89b3f4c6ea76.png"][/img][b]New Mobs![/b][/p][p]Various new mobs have been spotted on some planet surfaces...[/p][p][b]Game loading issue fixed![/b][/p][p]Players that have been experiencing issues launching the game [b][i]should[/i][/b] now be able to start it up without any problems.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Full Changelog:[/b][/p][p]NEW STUFF
- Added 5 new mobs: Locy, Lizzard, Oopus, Swrat and QQQQQQQQQQQ.
- Added 1 new anomaly: "???"
- Armorclads, Molebears, Thropes, Nozzers and White Hawks now have new behaviour dependant on the time of day.
- Added Nlug shield SFX.
- Added Boss theme when fighting boss mobs.
- Added a way to acquire blueprints from Krtola without having to fight him, and an achievement to go along with that.
- Added new UI for torch wood expenditure in certain expeditions.
- Added a new popup on entering certain expeditions for information about the torch mechanic.
- Added an animated icon for expedition entrances/exits.
- Added a new decoration for the Humans - the Campfire.
- Added more information on planet screen for attributes Atmosphere, Temperature and Water.
- Pezari Technology Tree now replaces the technology "Boats" with "Aquatic Flames." (-20% fuel usage in expeditions and the ability to melt frozen lakes)
- Pezari "Blubber" tech, besides providing cold protection, now also provides -20% fuel usage in expeditions and the ability to melt frozen lakes.
- Silexus can now pull island trees aswell.
- Added more animals to Seeker's animal pool. (Nozzer, Spard, Hamzly)[/p][p]BALANCING
- After Krtola attacks, he now has a 1.5sec cooldown period before digging down.
- Great Weed's attacks are now jukable.
- Yellow and red dots on the minimap no longer move if they are not within vision.
- Cooldown for Salamander stealing ability is now global.
- Units now get freed 15 seconds after being locked in crystal from Crystal Kom's effect.
- Gexis buildings now degrade 25% faster during normal rain. (Previously 0%)
- Pezari now get a "Dry" status effect after not being in water for 2 minutes. (-25% to all stats)
- Units should now target a nearby enemy if their target got killed.
- Tchuries and Bcelos now spawn on the surface of Ice Age planets.
- AI units that consume berries, like Thrope, now heal upon eating.
- Limited expeditions to 3 per planet.[/p][p]BUGS
- [b][i]HOPEFULLY[/i][/b] fixed the save file problem that people have been experiencing upon booting up the game. (All save data moved to /NettleData/)
- Fixed bug where Armorclad would end up on the wrong team after loyalty period ended.
- Fixed bug where Armorclad would not roam after roaming once.
- Fixed an issue where Krako spawning would cause errors.
- Fixed an issue where Swatters would be above the tree variation.
- Fixed an issue where only one unit was highlighted to enter barracks, but more entered.
- Fixed a bug where Pezari buff disappeared upon entering caves/ruins/tombs.
- Fixed a bug where Volcano biome would not heat up units in Ice Age.
- Fixed a bug where scorched trees would not crumble upon getting picked up by Silexus.
- Fixed a bug where the Volcano exit didn't provide any light.
- Fixed a bug where Kegawaki's second decoration building's flower variant didn't work.
- Fixed an issue where Pezari were able to swim in ice.
- Nozzer should no longer apply needles to targets that range attacked it.
- Armorclad charge attack should now be unstoppable.
- Fixed a bug where Greyers never played their special animation.
- Fixed a bug where Yetty picking up a unit left an effect they have behind. (stun/ice/etc)
- Fixed a bug where Dogork would not take any damage.
- Fixed an issue regarding Shard Drop SFX not playing in crystal caves.
- Fixed an issue where Gexis building degradation was active on buildings that are not player buildings. (Nests)
- Fixed an issue where Humans could no longer fire their bow.
- Fixed a bug where Pezari would attack from bow range in water if they had arrows in their inventories.
- Fixed a rare bug that made Pezari able to attack from infinite range using spears.
- Construction sprites for Gexis Research Lab and Kegawaki Refinery are now properly colored.
- Fixed bug where Thrope next pivot was incorrectly placed.
- Fixed bug where rock variation from Silexus picking up a rock was incorrect.
- Fixed bug where Frozen lake in Ice Age would still have moving water and use the incorrect sprite.
- Fixed bug where recruiting units like Armorclad in caves would not give them light.
- Fixed bug that made some expedition bosses not drop any blueprints.
- Fixed a bug that enabled excess blueprints generation per planet.
- Fixed a bug that made it so the Tomb expedition from the Tomb World anomaly would not spawn any blueprints.
- Fixed a bug that made Krtola unable to hit units directly under him.
- Krtola can no longer be hit while in the ground.
- Hamzly audio adjustment.[/p][p]REWORKS
- Additional code refactoring.
- All sound is now loaded on separate threads.
- Refactored the Music Player.[/p]

notes.title: Version B17
notes.content:
Welcome to our newest and arguably biggest "new content" update! We're hot and we're cold. Although I am more of a winter kinda guy. Here's the highlights, and the full changelog at the bottom:

[b]Volcano[/b]
An entire new anomaly, new biome, four new creatures and more dedicated for the hot part of this update!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45188207/fb8f5bad26b0a6f24479da19069e75d047f852b5.png"][/img]

[b]The Snowy Taiga[/b]
The taiga is a treacherous place full of unforgiving creatures and a new boss enemy, which we will not spoil for you.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45188207/951e985b0aca006e1141ad1ef9e875d35189d0c6.png"][/img]

[b]Shiny Water[/b]
The texture of the water has been reworked, and now looks much better. The screenshot doesn't do it justice, it looks waaay better when it's moving. Take a peek!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45188207/238a3c58645c32185fb4881205d4298a71436a01.png[/img]

[b]Full Changelog:[/b]
NEW STUFF
- Added 1 new anomaly, "Active Volcano."
- Added 2 new expeditions, the Snowy Taiga and the Volcano.
- Added 8 new creatures: Tchury, Bcelo, Njidra, Small Njidra, Siifle, Nlug, Galvanizator and Gren.
- Added scorched versions of resources and a scorched biome.
- Added lava pools and lava pillar obstacle.
- Water has a new look using advanced shader technology™.
- You will now be warned when your game version is incompatible when attempting to load a game.

BUGS
- Fixed bug where damaging effects such as Poison and Burn would instantly kill the target instead of playing their death animation.
- All expedition spawn points should now have spawn protection.
- Fixed bug where clusters of Nests would cause errors.
- Fixed Balloris shadow sticking to her during her jump animation.
- Unstunnable characters should no longer have a stun visual.
- Fixed bug where animals would infinitely regenerate health.
- Tremur and Tvake traps should now play animations.

REWORKS
- Bigger characters now create a bigger splash upon entering water.
- Biome counts are now limited by planet size aswell as flora amount. (Previously just flora amount)

notes.title: Version B16.2
notes.content:
Been a while, hasn't it? Today we're bringing you lighting and weather! As always, at the bottom of the post is the full changelog. Here come the highlights:

[b]Lighting[/b]
Who's afraid of the dark? Oh, also, blueprints now glow so you can't miss 'em.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45188207/0bfd1af62aceb6dd37f19fba3a11d9b1e6f72a9b.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45188207/228d1494f526293ca77cd025822ac4b7fe1fdfd4.png[/img]

[b]Rain[/b]
Rainfall has arrived! Some expeditions might be flooded from the excess rain caused by our new anomaly, "Heavy Rains."
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45188207/14dbfbcfec0d1ab07df121e96f4c41a932df1b51.png[/img]

[b]Full Changelog:[/b]
NEW STUFF
- Added lighting. Тёмная ночь...
- Added rain and anomaly "Heavy Rains," making some expeditions flooded.
- Added degradation effect to Gexis buildings.
- Blueprints now glow in the dark.
- Nests are now marked on the minimap.
- Dead bushes are now harvestable.

BALANCING
- Gexis structures collapse 50% faster during Heavy Rains.
- Balloris and Dogork spawn naturally in flooded expeditions.
- During normal rain, Pezari buff depletion rate reduced by 50%.
- During heavy rain, Pezari buff depletion rate halted.
- Planets with Heavy Rains will not have Balloris nests, instead Ballorises will spawn naturally during rainfall.
- During heavy rain, growth speed of plants increased by 100%.

BUGS
- Fixed a typo in Kegawaki description localization.
- Fixed Molebear bug in code that randomly made it stop working.
- Fixed tutorial and settings resetting after every update.
- Fixed units being behind the circle display for expedition entrances/exits.
- You no longer lose wood in caves if no units are alive.
- Fixed Kegawaki biting can stay in prone mode if the creature is fast enough.
- Fixed Armorclad charge attack speed.
- Fixed Armorclad attacking expedition entrances/exits.
- Fixed Armorclad charge attack cooldown bug.
- Fixed game having a small chance to freeze when loading in/out of an expedition.

REWORKS
- Save data has been moved to "My Documents/Nettle/Saves/" from "<game directory>/Assets/Resources/Saves/."
- White Hawk unit has been re-programmed entirely.
- A lot of code optimizations and fixes to bugs caused by the addition of lighting.
- Updated SFX volume files to complement eachother. Everything should sound a lot nicer now.

notes.title: Version B15
notes.content:
This time, we are addressing our UI and adding a whole new expedition for planets with the Tomb World anomaly. At the bottom of the post is the full changelog, but here's some highlights:

[b]Tomb World![/b]
The anomaly has received a brand new expedition with new enemies and a new boss. I'm not going to spoil the boss, it's really cool though!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45188207/2d2a2877915e826f2098aed7809bcf2e5c79af05.png[/img]

[b]Big Balancing Changes![/b]
The changes mainly affect Gexis, since they can now send up to 4 units to a single task, their buildings now slowly take damage and need to be rebuilt, everything they harvest they get 20% food from the original resource, etc...

Oh, also, units in underground expeditions now use torches, so keep an eye out for your fuel count, otherwise everything will eventually go dark.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45188207/50e10ed43637ba998aabbf3d3b4d9defa6b0c2d7.png[/img]

[b]New UI![/b]
Out with the old, in with the new! The UI now takes up less space in the game and looks waaayyy nicer.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45188207/8ac0f80ce8da9e2591e363e6bb1fc11265a17d65.png[/img]

[b]Full Changelog:[/b]
NEW STUFF
- Added Tomb expedition on planets with the Tomb World anomaly.
- Added ???, Tall Golem.
- Added more ruin type resources in the expedition.
- New UI for the resource count, unit & skill tab and for selecting a species on game start.
- New UI icon animations for Decorations, Buildings, Units and Ships.
- Being in underground expeditions, units will use torches and expend 5 wood every 10 seconds.
- Added 1 new achievement: Secrets of the Universe.
- Added a healing ability for Silexus.
- Added knockup effect for player units.
- If you have enough resources to make units, the game will no longer end when all player units perish.
- Entrances and exits to expeditions are now marked on the minimap and are no longer hidden in fog of war when explored.
- Abilities are now grayed out when on cooldown.
- The night is now darker.
- Upon reaching maximum resources, the color of the count now turns red.

BALANCING
- Negative planet attributes now all reduce maximum health by -20%.
- Gexis buildings now slowly take damage and need to be rebuilt with stone, wood and food.
- Gexis now gain 80% of the resource they are harvesting and the remaining 20% as food.
- Gexis can now have up to 4 units work on a single task. (building/gathering)
- Gexis ranged attacks now deal 2.5 base damage and 5 with tech. (previously 5 and 10 respectively)
- Gexis now harvest 50% slower.
- Gexis now cost 4 upkeep to maintain.
- Humans now cost 5 upkeep to maintain.
- Humans and Pezari now need to refill their arrows/spears at the Town Hall.
- Silexus units now cost 100 stone. (previously 20)
- Kegawaki now gain 25% less food from bushes.
- Krtola now applies a knockup when digging out of the ground.
- Armorclads will now all get aggro if one is attacked.
- Armorclad charge damage is now doubled.
- Spard now deals 2.5 damage per second (previously 1)
- New AI behaviors for Thrope, Krako, Balloris, Dogork and Tumbler based on the time of day.


BUGS
- Fixed barbed wire disappearing after loading a save.
- Fixed being unable to put flowers on decoration buildings on planets with Crystal Formations and Ice Age.
- Fixed seeds despawning after entering an expedition.
- Fixed being able to walk through seeds after placing them.
- Fixed Pezari storage being invisible on placement.
- Fixed Pezari pool sprite not having color and wrong size.
- Fixed Great Weed not becoming a bush again, not attacking Balloris and losing aggro.
- Fixed Balloris jumping behind things in the air.
- Fixed Balloris roaming far away from her nest.
- Fixed Golem sometimes bugging out and stopping in place.
- Fixed units spawning on top of the starting Pod building.
- Fixed ground crack patches coloring.
- Fixed sprites of Overkill and Destiny being swapped.
- Fixed no footsteps in jungle.
- Fixed Gexis having infinite range on ranged attacks.
- Removed Balloris shadow in water.
- Fixed bush not working on crystal formations.
- Fixed minimap icons not generating.
- Fixed tutorial screen to match the new UI.
- Fixed a movement speed calculation bug.
- Fixed Biochemists glitching out after using their ability.
- Fixed 15% prone speed increase technology not working.
- Fixed Armorclad being affected by health decrease.

REWORKS
- General optimization and refactoring of the code.
- Improvement of unit collision.
- Patch generation changes to better show lushness.
- Berries now grow green before turning red.

notes.title: Version B14
notes.content:
Hey everyone, happy holidays and happy new year! Just before ending the year off, we managed to finish the B14 update. At the bottom of the post is the full changelog, but I'll go over what's most important and probably most interesting for everyone here.

[b]Variations![/b]
All player units can now have a color variation!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45188207/87947f021cd52f70800ab91195c6b47564d3db61.png[/img]
This extends to some mobs aswell.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45188207/7d4c3b533aaf934192405829ab88b86096ad26c6.png[/img]

[b]New Stuff![/b]
The vegetation bar on the planet select screen now directly impacts world generation, including what and how many biomes will generate. If the vegetation is too low, you might find a lot of "dead" flora and mobs specific for that planet!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45188207/a15e8bf69f8d4f775b3f89fc251eca654841fcb0.png[/img]
2 new decorational buildings you can construct as the Humans (Well) and as the Kegawaki! (Tiki)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45188207/2371d7ee6e2e38f41f9480967b09e3c4c2a9c781.png[/img]

[b]Balancing![/b]
The Atmosphere, Water and Temperature aspects of a planet now directly affect your civilization, depending on if they're good for your species or not. On the picture below is an example for the best possible planet and the worst possible planet for Gexis and how it affects their health points. Health points cannot go lower than 40% of the original amount, to ensure that the game is not impossible to beat.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45188207/db90b68b2d26ccf2d4ce902dfcbaed22105f4f94.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45188207/0b75af9326886c5b74ba7b45da5e219e0fd9a238.png[/img]

[b]Full Changelog:[/b]
NEW STUFF
- All player units can now spawn with a color variation.
- Tremur, Thrope and Greyer have an icy variation for the Ice Age anomaly.
- Added 1 new mob: Tumbler.
- Added Dead Bushes and Dead Trees.
- Added 2 new deocration buildings: Well for Humans, Tiki for Kegawaki.
- Added 1 new achievement.
- Vegetation bar now affects spawns of biomes, units and resources like Dead Bushes and Dead Trees.
- Human arrows got a new look.
- Balloris has new AI.
- Units are now highlighted green when entering/exiting an expedition.
- Updated jungle entrance/exit sprite.
- Exiting to main menu now has a confirm box.
- Credits and Expedition themes now added.
- Snowy HUD now fades in/out.
- New HUD effect inside the Deep Forest.

BALANCING
- Barracks tech swapped with Refinery tech.
- Planet penalties are now active in game.
  This means that red stats on planets (Atmosphere, Water and Temperature) now directly affect your entire civilization.
- Silexus are now indifferent to temperatures.
- Decoration buildings prices decreased.
- Salamanders can now spawn in the overworld ruins.
- Slight increase to Balloris shockwave hitbox.
- Ruin obstacles are now minable resources.
- Seeds now cost 20 food instead of 50 refined.
- Humans now heal during the entire day, instead of at the beginning.
- Human arrows now deal 10 damage. (previously 5)

BUGS
- Fixed cave entrance using the crystal entrance sprite.
- Fixed unconstructed watchtower firing arrows at enemies.
- Fixed watchtower aim.
- Fixed hovering on red Thropes making them go back to normal Thropes.
- Fixed second tree type being invincible in the Mushroom biome.
- Fixed scales of patches after loading a save.
- Fixed walking sounds being heard outside Fog of War.
- Fixed animation of Main Menu buttons.
- Fixed Nozzer needle being visible outside Fog of War.
- Fixed Swatter audio being too low.
- Fixed Spard walking animation not playing.
- Fixed music themes not looping.
- Fixed Silexus picking up snowballs if multiple try for the same resource.
- Fixed Gexis not being passively healed over time.
- Fixed Biochemist spawning on top of the laboratory instead of in front of it.
- Fixed Biochemist's enhance ability.
- Fixed a bug where there could be more than 1 Biochemist on 1 save.
- Fixed a localization bug in human politics that appears on some computers.
- Fixed rare bug that teleports units to a wrong location upon entering/exiting an expedition.
- Fixed Human coats no longer applying.
- Fixed a bug that spawned water lakes under biomes.
- Fixed marker for Dore not being properly aligned.
- Fixed flowers transferring between saves.
- Fixed an issue where you could station Biochemists inside buildings.
- Fixed right-clicking after selecting a planet switching you to the space view screen.
- Fixed a rare game crash on save/load while alt-tabbing.
- Fixed last frame of Human death animation.

REWORKS
- Reworked Day/Night system. Should no longer be buggy.
- Reworked coloring system.
- Made the world generation a bit better.
